errors.basis_quote_required: A basis lead time quote is required.
errors.catalogue_entry_required: A supplier catalogue lead time needs the catalogue entry.
errors.catalogue_lead_mismatch: The lead time does not match the supplier catalogue entry it names.
errors.catalogue_retired: This catalogue is retired and cannot be pinned.
errors.classification_frozen: Critical and long-lead overrides are frozen once the procurement route is set.
errors.commitment_currency_mismatch: The reservation fee and the released commitment are in different currencies.
errors.commitment_for_other_item: The linked commitment item belongs to another plant item.
errors.commitment_not_found: The linked commitment item is not part of this project.
errors.commitment_not_released: The linked commitment item is not released yet.
errors.commitment_release_below_fee: The released amount is lower than the reservation fee.
errors.commitment_release_failed: The commitment release could not be read; try again or contact the administrator.
errors.commitment_release_unavailable: The commitment release cannot be read, so a reservation fee cannot be bound.
errors.concurrent_basis_change: Another user changed the basis quote at the same time; reload and retry.
errors.cost_needs_currency: An option's cost needs its currency.
errors.critical_without_decision: A critical item needs an approved decision paper before its route is set.
errors.critical_without_market_evidence: A critical item needs a lead time from the market, not a catalogue default or an estimate.
errors.critical_without_strategic_spares: A critical item needs a strategic spare or a stated reason why not.
errors.decision_paper_needs_two_options: A decision paper needs at least two options unless the item is sole source.
errors.decision_route_refused: The approval route refused this step.
errors.delivery_limit_gap: Not every delivery step has a responsible party.
errors.edit_permission_required: You do not have permission to change the plant register.
errors.enquiry_date_in_future: The enquiry date cannot be in the future.
errors.fee_needs_currency: A reservation fee needs its currency.
errors.fee_negative: The reservation fee cannot be negative.
errors.handover_needs_commissioned: Only a commissioned item can be handed over.
errors.handover_needs_service_asset: Name the service contract for the asset, or state why the item is handed over without one.
errors.invalid_transition: This state change is not possible from the current state.
errors.it_cde_not_linked: CDE access needs a linked CDE container.
errors.it_service_range_invalid: The service ends before it starts.
errors.it_service_retired: A retired IT service cannot be changed.
errors.item_closed: The item is handed over or cancelled.
errors.item_code_taken: An item with this code already exists in the project.
errors.laydown_zone_not_found: This laydown zone does not exist in this project.
errors.lead_time_owned_by_plant_item: The lead time of this submittal is kept on its plant item.
errors.lead_time_stale: The basis lead time quote is older than the class allows.
errors.lead_time_without_enquiry_date: A lead time needs the date it was enquired.
errors.lead_weeks_range_invalid: Lead time minimum must not exceed the maximum.
errors.limit_needs_party: A delivery step needs a party or a package.
errors.link_not_found: The linked record is not part of this project.
errors.long_lead_override_needs_reason: Overriding the long-lead classification needs a reason.
errors.manage_required: Only a holder of the plant management permission may change this.
errors.neutral_spec_names_vendor: The specification is vendor-neutral but names a vendor.
errors.no_decision_route: The project has no approval route for decision papers.
errors.not_equipment_owner: Only a manager or the owner of the equipment area may change the plant register.
errors.package_not_found: The contract package is not part of this project's package plan.
errors.package_plan_failed: The delivery model could not be read; try again or contact the administrator.
errors.package_plan_unavailable: The project's package plan cannot be read, so the route cannot be checked.
errors.paper_not_draft: Only a draft paper can be changed or submitted.
errors.paper_not_submitted: Only a submitted paper can be withdrawn.
errors.paper_open: The item already has an open decision paper.
errors.paper_option_codes_invalid: Every option needs a unique code.
errors.paper_recommendation_unknown: The recommendation must name one of the options.
errors.paper_scores_invalid: Scores and weights must be decimal numbers.
errors.paper_submitter_is_approver: The person who submits the paper cannot be an approver of its route.
errors.position_incomplete: A position needs its kind and its point on the site plan.
errors.position_not_found: This plant position does not exist in this project.
errors.position_number_invalid: This number cannot be stored: check the decimals and the size.
errors.position_range_invalid: The position ends before it starts.
errors.position_text_invalid: This text is empty or too long.
errors.quantity_not_positive: Quantity must be greater than zero.
errors.response_before_enquiry: The response date cannot be before the enquiry date.
errors.route_frozen: The route cannot change once the item is ordered.
errors.route_inconsistent_with_package_plan: The procurement route does not match the package plan.
errors.slot_exists: The item already has an open capacity reservation.
errors.slot_fee_needs_commitment: A reservation fee binds money only through a commitment release; link the commitment item.
errors.slot_range_invalid: The slot ends before it starts.
errors.slot_terms_incomplete: A held reservation needs fee, refund terms and the conversion deadline.
errors.spare_closed: The spare part line is closed.
errors.spare_not_deletable: Only a spare line that is still required can be deleted.
errors.spares_not_handed_over: Every spare part must be handed over or waived first.
errors.specification_frozen: The specification is frozen once the procurement route is set.
errors.stage_not_found: This expansion stage does not exist in this project.
errors.stage_unavailable: Expansion stages cannot be read, so a position cannot be put on one.
errors.state_read_from_source: This state is read from the order, owner-furnished item or commissioning, not set by hand.
errors.transition_blocked: The state change is blocked by several rules.
errors.two_parties_on_one_step: A delivery step can have only one party.

errors.unknown_site_plant_kind: This kind of site plant is not in the project's plant catalogue.
errors.unknown_vendor_bound_reason: Reason must be standardisation, existing estate, warranty or sole source.
errors.unknown_vendor_policy: Vendor policy must be neutral or bound.
errors.vendor_bound_needs_reason: A vendor-bound specification needs a reason.
errors.waiver_needs_reason: Waiving a spare part needs a reason.

evidence.critical_route_set: Every critical item has its route set with an approved decision paper
evidence.frame_document_attached: Equipment frame document attached to the CDE
evidence.frame_document_missing: The project has no equipment frame document yet, so its attachment cannot be checked
evidence.host_unresolved: The governance model does not say which area and gate the plant register reports to
evidence.long_lead_secured: Every long-lead item has a fresh basis quote and is ordered or within its order date
evidence.no_area_hosts_plant: The phase model names no area that hosts plant, so the plant register cannot report to a gate
evidence.no_error_findings: No error-level findings in the plant register
evidence.no_phase_enables_construction_start: The phase model names no phase that enables the start of construction, so the plant register has no gate to report to

reasons.currency: the reservation fee has no currency
reasons.installer_mismatch: the owner-furnished item names another installing package
reasons.owner_furnished_item_required: an owner-furnished route needs its owner-furnished item
reasons.owner_installs: the owner installs, so no contract package may be named as installer
reasons.package_does_not_supply: the contract package does not supply plant
reasons.package_not_in_plan: the contract package is not in the package plan
reasons.package_required: this route needs a contract package
reasons.single_package_form: the delivery form has one contract package and the item is in another

critical_has_decision_paper.fail: Critical item {item} has no approved decision paper.
critical_has_decision_paper.suggestion: Prepare the option paper and submit it for approval.

critical_has_market_evidence.fail: Critical item {item} relies on a catalogue default or an estimate.
critical_has_market_evidence.suggestion: Obtain a supplier quote, framework or historic order.

critical_has_strategic_spares.fail: Critical item {item} has no strategic spare.
critical_has_strategic_spares.suggestion: Add a strategic spare or state why none is needed.

delivery_limits_complete.fail: Delivery limits of {item} have no party for: {steps}.
delivery_limits_complete.suggestion: Assign a party to every delivery step.

it_cde_linked.fail: CDE access needed before the execution gate has no CDE container.
it_cde_linked.suggestion: Link the CDE container the parties will work in.

lead_time_fresh.fail: The basis lead time of {item} is out of date.
lead_time_fresh.suggestion: Ask the supplier again and record the new answer.

lead_time_has_enquiry_date.fail: Long-lead item {item} has no lead time quote with an enquiry date.
lead_time_has_enquiry_date.suggestion: Record a dated quote: when you asked and who answered.

order_not_overdue.suggestion: Order now or move the need date with the schedule owner.

redundancy_quantity.fail: Quantity of {item} does not fit its redundancy scheme.
redundancy_quantity.suggestion: Check the quantity against the scheme (N+1 needs at least two units).

route_consistent_with_package_plan.fail: Procurement route of {item} does not match the package plan: {reason}.
route_consistent_with_package_plan.suggestion: Align the route with the contract packages and owner-furnished items.

single_basis_quote.fail: {item} does not have exactly one basis quote.
single_basis_quote.suggestion: Mark one quote as the basis.

slot_after_order_date.fail: Capacity reservation of {item} runs past the latest order date.
slot_after_order_date.suggestion: Sign the order earlier or negotiate an earlier slot.

slot_not_expired.fail: Capacity reservation of {item} passed its conversion deadline.
slot_not_expired.suggestion: Convert it to an order or release it.

slot_terms_complete.fail: Capacity reservation of {item} has incomplete terms.
slot_terms_complete.suggestion: Record fee, refund terms, conversion deadline and the commitment link.

vendor_bound_has_reason.suggestion: A bound specification needs a reason; a neutral one names no vendor.
